⚖️ The duality of fog

😑 Zero view while you're in it, but an awesome view if you can rise above it! 😎

🌫️ This valley fog in eastern Taranaki has formed every day this week, and you might be able to spot some familiar landmarks in the far distance ⛰️⛰️🏔️

📸 Chur Primo Broadband for the webcam footage 👌👌
